For visitors

Registration opens the Monday before each ride and runs six days. Non-members use TBN’s $15 30-day trial. Arrive 15 minutes early. Check the schedule after 8:00 am on ride day for weather cancellations.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 15–18 km/h: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Sunday Leisure Wheeler group ride

Sunday Leisure Wheeler is a social group ride in Toronto, Canada. It rolls every Sunday at 10:00 am local time from Changes weekly (Oct 4, 2026: Oriole Park).

TBN’s slow Sunday ride, built for entry-level riders, people coming back to cycling after a long break, and seniors. Paved trails and streets at 15 to 18 km/h with frequent regroups. Bring lunch on the longer ones.
